responsibility: This header declares the public interface to the mc front end's symbolKey symbol-table abstraction. It defines the opaque symbolKey_symbolTree handle plus callback record types for predicate testing and in-order visitation, and exports the operations for creating and destroying a tree, mapping interned nameKey_Name identifiers to arbitrary payload pointers, deleting entries, testing emptiness, searching for any node matching a supplied predicate, and traversing all symbols in order.
same_name_distinction: Declares the opaque symbolKey tree handle, callback record types, and public operations for nameKey-based symbol tables; unlike GsymbolKey.cc it hides the node structure and contains no tree-manipulation implementation.
